speaker: mission_control
spanish: {kerbal}, te vemos en cámara. Saluda.
english: {kerbal}, we have you on camera. Wave.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo tranquilo por aquí abajo. ¿Y ahí fuera?
english: All quiet down here. And out there?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recuerda: un pie delante del otro.
english: Remember: one foot in front of the other.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Respira despacio. El aire del traje no es infinito.
english: Breathe slowly. The suit air isn't endless.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Seguimos tu señal. Muy bonita, por cierto.
english: We're tracking your signal. Very pretty, by the way.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paseo espacial en curso. Medio centro de control está mirando.
english: EVA in progress. Half of Mission Control is watching.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mochila al {jet} por ciento. Hay para volar un rato.
english: Jetpack at {jet} percent. Enough to fly around a bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te queda el {jet} por ciento de propulsor. No lo gastes en piruetas.
english: {jet} percent propellant left. Don't spend it on flips.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Propulsor al {jet} por ciento. Vuelve antes de quedarte flotando.
english: Propellant at {jet} percent. Come back before you're left floating.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Solo el {jet} por ciento en la mochila. Nada de acrobacias.
english: Only {jet} percent in the jetpack. No stunts.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estás a {ship_m} metros de {vessel}. No te alejes más.
english: You're {ship_m} meters from {vessel}. Don't go any further.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {ship_m} metros hasta la nave. Así nos gusta, con correa corta.
english: {ship_m} meters to the ship. We like a short leash.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya vas por {ship_m} metros. La nave te echa de menos.
english: {ship_m} meters already. The ship misses you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sigues muy cerca de la nave. Muy prudente.
english: Still right next to the ship. Very sensible.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La escotilla está ahí mismo. Por si acaso.
english: The hatch is right there. Just in case.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Llevas {eva_mins} minutos fuera. ¿Todo bien con el traje?
english: {eva_mins} minutes outside. Suit still fine?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {eva_mins} minutos de paseo. Eso ya cuenta como deporte.
english: {eva_mins} minutes of walking. That counts as exercise.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {eva_mins} minutos fuera. Alguien te ha guardado la cena.
english: {eva_mins} minutes out. Someone saved you dinner.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya van {eva_mins} minutos. Dentro preguntan si te has mudado.
english: {eva_mins} minutes now. Inside they ask if you moved out.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cómo es el suelo de {here}? ¿Blando? ¿Duro? ¿Comestible?
english: How's the ground on {here}? Soft? Hard? Edible?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mira bien dónde pisas. Y no lamas las piedras.
english: Watch your step. And don't lick the rocks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recoge una piedra bonita para el museo.
english: Pick up a nice rock for the museum.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estás de paseo por {biome}. Muy turístico.
english: You're out for a walk in {biome}. Very touristy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {biome}. Buen sitio para estirar las piernas.
english: {biome}. Good spot to stretch your legs.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Huellas en {here}. Las fotos van a ser históricas.
english: Footprints on {here}. The photos will be historic.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres el kerbal más lejos de casa que conocemos. Bueno, uno de ellos.
english: You're the farthest kerbal from home we know. Well, one of them.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paseo por casa. Saluda a los vecinos.
english: A walk at home. Say hi to the neighbors.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un paseo por {body}. Muy valiente, con lo cerca que está el bar.
english: A walk on {body}. Very brave, with the bar so close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No mires abajo. Bueno, mira, que es bonito.
english: Don't look down. Well, do, it's pretty.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estás fuera de la nave, en órbita. Eso sí que es valor.
english: You're outside the ship, in orbit. Now that's courage.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Agárrate a algo. Lo que sea.
english: Hold on to something. Anything.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {ship_m} metros de vacío entre tú y la nave. Ve con calma.
english: {ship_m} meters of nothing between you and the ship. Take it slow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Día {day} de misión y por fin sales a tomar el aire.
english: Mission day {day}, and you finally get some fresh air.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Día {day}. Un buen día para salir de paseo.
english: Day {day}. A good day for a walk.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Aquí fuera se está de maravilla.
english: It's lovely out here.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Paso a paso.
english: Copy. Step by step.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No toco nada. Casi nada.
english: Not touching anything. Almost nothing.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Alguien ha visto mi casco? Ah, lo llevo puesto.
english: Has anyone seen my helmet? Oh, I'm wearing it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Todo bien. El traje huele un poco raro, pero bien.
english: All good. The suit smells a bit odd, but good.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Piruetas? Yo nunca haría eso.
english: Flips? I would never.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Entendido. Solo una pirueta pequeñita.
english: Understood. Just one tiny flip.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Solo voy a ver qué hay detrás de esa roca.
english: Just checking what's behind that rock.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Tranquilos. Sé volver. Creo.
english: Relax. I know the way back. I think.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Huele a aventura. Y un poco a calcetín.
english: Smells like adventure. And a bit like socks.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Demasiado tarde. Ya he lamido una. Sabe a polvo.
english: Too late. I already licked one. Tastes like dust.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No pienso soltarme. Nunca. Jamás.
english: I'm not letting go. Ever. Never.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Las vistas valen cada segundo de miedo.
english: The view is worth every second of fear.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Ya? Se me ha pasado volando. Bueno, caminando.
english: Already? It flew by. Well, walked by.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Guardadme el postre también.
english: Save me dessert too.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bandera plantada. Desde aquí se ve casi recta.
english: Flag planted. From here it looks almost straight.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tenemos bandera. Esto ya es oficialmente nuestro. O del primero que lo reclame.
english: We have a flag. This is officially ours now. Or whoever claims it first.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bonita bandera. ¿La has planchado antes de salir?
english: Nice flag. Did you iron it before you left?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bandera en su sitio. Que nadie la use de percha.
english: Flag in place. Nobody use it as a coat hanger.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bandera {flag} plantada. Bonito nombre. ¿Quién lo eligió?
english: Flag {flag} planted. Nice name. Who picked it?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Así que se llama {flag}. Lo apuntamos en el mapa.
english: So it's called {flag}. We'll put it on the map.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {kerbal}, la bandera te queda muy bien. Bueno, al suelo.
english: {kerbal}, the flag suits you. Well, it suits the ground.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen trabajo, {kerbal}. Ahora haz una foto con ella.
english: Good work, {kerbal}. Now take a picture with it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una bandera en {here}. Historia. O por lo menos una buena foto.
english: A flag on {here}. History. Or at least a nice photo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {here} tiene una bandera nueva. No sabemos si la quería.
english: {here} has a new flag. We don't know if it wanted one.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una bandera en {biome}. El sitio perfecto, nadie se va a quejar.
english: A flag in {biome}. Perfect spot, nobody will complain.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una bandera en casa. Muy patriótico. Y muy cerca.
english: A flag at home. Very patriotic. And very close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Plantar banderas en {body} también cuenta. Un poco.
english: Planting flags on {body} counts too. A bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una bandera tan lejos de casa. El comité de banderas está llorando de emoción.
english: A flag this far from home. The flag committee is crying with joy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bandera plantada lejos de casa. Los libros de historia tendrán que hacer sitio.
english: A flag far from home. The history books will have to make room.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bandera a {ship_m} metros de la nave. Así la encuentras al volver. Quizá.
english: Flag {ship_m} meters from the ship. So you can find it on the way back. Maybe.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La he clavado sin ayuda. Bueno, la gravedad ayudó.
english: I planted it with no help. Well, gravity helped.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Está un poco torcida. Es estilo.
english: It's a little crooked. That's style.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Reclamo este sitio para los kerbals. Y para los sándwiches.
english: I claim this place for kerbals. And for sandwiches.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La bandera es mía. El polvo también.
english: The flag is mine. The dust too.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Que conste que la he puesto recta. Es el suelo, que está torcido.
english: For the record, I put it in straight. The ground is crooked.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Le he dado un abrazo. No se lo digáis a nadie.
english: I gave it a hug. Don't tell anyone.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: El nombre lo elegí yo. Tardé tres días.
english: I picked the name. Took me three days.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Iba a llamarla Bandera, pero era muy obvio.
english: I was going to call it Flag, but that was too obvious.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ya estoy posando. Este es mi lado bueno.
english: Already posing. This is my good side.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Foto? Espera, que me peino el casco.
english: A photo? Wait, let me comb my helmet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Flotas en {here}. El traje parece un barco muy pequeño.
english: You're floating on {here}. The suit looks like a very small boat.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Qué tal el agua? No hace falta probarla.
english: How's the water? No need to taste it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mantén el casco cerrado. No estamos probando un submarino.
english: Keep the helmet shut. This isn't a submarine test.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te vemos usando la mochila sobre {here}. Impulsos cortos.
english: We see you using the jetpack above {here}. Short bursts.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cada impulso cambia tu órbita alrededor de {here}. Apunta hacia la nave.
english: Every burst changes your orbit around {here}. Aim toward the ship.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mochila al {jet} por ciento sobre {here}. Guarda suficiente para volver.
english: Jetpack at {jet} percent above {here}. Save enough to get back.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: El traje flota. Yo intento parecer profesional.
english: The suit floats. I'm trying to look professional.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Impulsos cortos y nada de piruetas. Por ahora.
english: Copy. Short bursts and no flips. For now.
